gamefaqs.section: GameCube USB Memory Adapter Save (North America)

format: GCI: the 64-byte card directory entry (GM4E01, file 'MarioKart Double Dash!!', 3 blocks, modified 2016-04-03 19:16:50, comment 'Mario Kart: Double Dash!! / Game Data 04/03/16') then 3 x 8 KiB blocks = 24640 bytes

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/gc-gci.py place <file> <GC/USA/Card A>: copies the GCI unchanged into the GCI folder under Dolphin's own name for it

dolphin-emu.frontend: tools/retro-run, OpenGL 4.1 core context, options scripts/gc/dolphin-single-core.opt (CPU thread off, OSD off); save in <savedir>/User/GC/USA/Card A/ (the core's GCI folder)
dolphin-emu.detail: Title menu > RECORDS > GRAND PRIX, Mushroom Cup: JON, gold trophies and 40 points in all four classes (50cc 7:45:993); baseline (no save): the game asks to create data and the script ends on HOW MANY PLAYERS?

dolphin-emu@dolphin.frontend: Dolphin.app, isolated user folder (-u), batch mode (-b), input from a TAS movie (-m) made with work/standalone/tools/gen_dtm.py, frame dump; save in <user>/GC/USA/Card A/ (GCI folder)
